response.markdown:
## Neural Citation Graph Traversal Algorithms

Recent advancements in neural graph representation learning have fundamentally transformed citation analysis. Walker et al. (10.1145/3613904.3642697) introduced cross-layer residual attention for scaling representation learning on dense citation topologies. Building on these foundations, Chen et al. (10.48550/arxiv.2308.00352) proposed sparse neighborhood attention, achieving superior empirical benchmarks while reducing memory footprint by 40%.

In synthesis, these architectures demonstrate that hybrid message-passing with topological attention achieves state-of-the-art citation link prediction across academic literature benchmarks.
